posts.title: Help put Terminal Tanks on Steam
posts.text:
Terminal Tanks is free and always will be. Putting it on Steam costs a one-time $100 fee, so there is now a Steam fund. Every tip goes straight toward that fee, and the bar on this page shows how close it is.

Tips go through Cash App ($CPMmoneyman). Thank you to everyone who plays, shares or chips in.

posts.title: Terminal Tanks is on itch.io and YouTube
posts.text:
Terminal Tanks now has a home on itch.io. You can play the full game right on the page, download the desktop version, and leave a tip. Every tip goes toward the one-time $100 fee to put the game on Steam.

Both trailers are on YouTube too: the 79-second launch trailer and the 3½-minute story trailer, which walks through the lore and every mode.

Version 2.0.1 adds both to the game's LINKS screen. Nothing else changes, and your saves carry over as they are.

posts.title: Terminal Tanks 2.0 is out, with a launch trailer
posts.text:
Version 2.0.0 is here, and the browser game, the download and every page of this site are built from it. The Martyr is now a true final boss, the UFO hunts ramp up properly, and the main menu shows the full TERMINAL TANKS logo on most screens. Your saves carry over as they are.

Under the hood the game has become a proper Python package with a player's guide and docs for anyone who wants to add tanks, ammo or maps of their own. It plays exactly as before.

There is also a launch trailer at the top of this page: a real session from launch to the first win, then everything that comes after.

posts.title: The site catches up: a Jukebox, a DS page and sound in the browser
posts.text:
The website is now in step with version 1.6.0. The catalog lists every tank, ammo type, map, home screen, paint, feature and boss in the game, and the animated paints play as short clips. The Workshop has every new part and lets you preview any paint and the HOVER upgrade.

The new Jukebox has all 277 songs from the game, recorded with the game's own synthesizer, with a turntable, an equalizer and a live spectrum analyser. The browser game now plays its music and sound effects too, and an X button charges the special attack on touch screens.

Terminal Tanks DS has its own page, with the ROM to download and real screenshots, and the Save forge now handles profiles, the Martyr and every paint. The story on the About page continues with Martyr's Blessing.

posts.title: A picture of everything, and a Workshop on the web
posts.text:
Every tank, ammo type, map, home screen and feature in the catalog now has a picture, drawn by the game's own code so it always matches what you see in play.

The new Workshop page lets you mix and match all 153 tank parts, watch your tank in motion, and save a build sheet that shows where each part comes from. Parts are tagged as free or by the tank that unlocks them.

posts.title: You can now download the game
posts.text:
TerminalTanks now has an Install page. You can still play in your browser, but the download runs with the best performance, works offline, and keeps your save as one plain file on your own disk.

The Save forge can move your progress between the browser version and the download, so nothing you have earned is stuck in one place.

posts.title: The big expansion is here
posts.text:
There is far more to unlock: 107 tanks, 107 ammo types, 79 home screens and 129 maps. A new premium tier sits above Master pricing, and the Workshop lets you build your own tanks from 129 parts and 24 accent colors.

The most expensive new item is the Terminal Ticket. Buy one and you fight a random boss from a pool of ten, each with its own tank, map and ammo. Beat a boss and it leaves the pool for good.

Two-player and LAN matches also gain map selection and a special attack. The catalog, cheat list and save forge on this site are all updated to match.

posts.title: The TerminalTanks site is open
posts.text:
The site now has a catalog of every tank, ammo type, map and home screen, a full list of cheat codes, and a save forge that builds or edits a save file you can import into the game.

You can still play in the browser from the Play button.
